listing.name: Red Neck Engineering - Arcade Mode 0.1.1
listing.summary: Adds a hullmod to modify ship maintenance costs and capacities via hot-reloadable settings.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a hullmod to modify ship maintenance costs and capacities via hot-reloadable settings.

description:
Red Neck Engineering - ArcadeMode

Adds a hullmod that modifies in a ship:

PPT, CR Degradation rate, Supplies Per Month, Supplies To Recover after a fight, Cargo capacity, Fuel capacity and Crew capacity

All of these values can be modified on the LunaLib settings in the main menu, without the need to reload the game (Hot changable).

Download:

https://github.com/OfficialZygorg/RedNeckEngineering_ArcadeMode/releases/tag/latest

Requires LazyLib:

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=5444.0

]

https://github.com/LazyWizard/lazylib

Requires LunaLib:

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=25658.0

https://github.com/Lukas22041/LunaLib

I just wanted to take my time doing stuff in SS without worrying about the ships maintenance resource drain, and here we are!

Credits on the modinfo.json

Changelog:

Spoiler0.1.1

SpoilerAdded:

- Versioning file

- Changelog file

- Update checker

- Placeholder mod image for TriOS

- Python script that makes a zip of the mod (Used ChatGPT because idk python)

Modified:

- Revamped LunaLib settings

- Revamped how the mod uses the settings

- Made the mod a utility mod

- Modified the README.md

- Modified the hullmod descriptions

Fixed:

- Lots of errors while Revamping

!Unknown compatibility with 0.1.0 and bellow!

!Unknown if you can disable the mod once you use it in a save!

[close][close]

Personal recommended mods:
